settings.text:
Changed your mind? Send us a cancellation request with your order number. Requests made within 24 hours of placing the order can be cancelled before your piece ships, with a full refund to your original payment method.

Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled, but you can still return it under our returns policy.
You can find your order number in your confirmation email, or in your account under Orders.
settings.subject: Order cancellation request

settings.title: When can I cancel?
settings.text: Within 24 hours of placing your order, before it ships.

settings.title: Refunds
settings.text: Cancelled orders are refunded in full to the original payment method.
